minutes.headline: Economic Development Committee met remotely to set event goals for the year; minutes approval was put off to an in-person meeting.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed member updates, chiefly the Lunenburg Business Association, and brainstormed goals: a September meet and greet, a holiday business crawl with stamp cards, an agricultural fair for the 2028 anniversary, and a shared events calendar. They also talked about the vacant storefront in the center, the warehouse and Lofa Farms projects, and a regional round table. Minutes approval was deferred and the meeting adjourned by roll call.

votes.motion: Motion to adjourn, seconded, followed by a roll call of members

decisions.decision: Approval of prior meeting minutes deferred to the next in-person meeting, with copies to be sent digitally.
Members agreed to put a September meet and greet and a December holiday business crawl on the goals list.
Next meeting is February 22nd, the fourth Thursday, at six o'clock in person.
